A VLAN ID is a number from 1 to 4094..es: Un ID de VLAN es un número del 1 al 4094.
A VLAN ID is a number from 1 to 4094..pt-BR: Um ID de VLAN é um número de 1 a 4094.
A VLAN ID is a number from 1 to 4094..fr: Un ID de VLAN est un nombre de 1 à 4094.
A VLAN ID is a number from 1 to 4094..de: Eine VLAN-ID ist eine Zahl von 1 bis 4094.
A VLAN ID is a number from 1 to 4094..id: ID VLAN adalah angka dari 1 sampai 4094.
A VLAN ID is a number from 1 to 4094..it: Un ID VLAN è un numero da 1 a 4094.
A VLAN ID is a number from 1 to 4094..tr: VLAN kimliği 1 ile 4094 arasında bir sayıdır.
A VLAN ID is a number from 1 to 4094..vi: VLAN ID là một số từ 1 đến 4094.
A VLAN ID is a number from 1 to 4094..pl: ID VLAN to liczba od 1 do 4094.
A VLAN ID is a number from 1 to 4094..hi: VLAN ID 1 से 4094 के बीच की संख्या होती है।

VLAN {id} is listed twice..it: La VLAN {id} è elencata due volte.
VLAN {id} is listed twice..vi: VLAN {id} bị liệt kê hai lần.
VLAN {id} is listed twice..hi: VLAN {id} दो बार लिखा गया है।

Enter the router's own address in the VL.es: Ingresa la dirección propia del router en la VLAN, como {ex}, no la dirección de red.
Enter the router's own address in the VL.pt-BR: Informe o endereço do próprio roteador na VLAN, como {ex}, e não o endereço de rede.
Enter the router's own address in the VL.fr: Saisissez l'adresse propre du routeur dans le VLAN, comme {ex}, et non l'adresse réseau.
Enter the router's own address in the VL.de: Geben Sie die eigene Adresse des Routers im VLAN ein, etwa {ex}, nicht die Netzadresse.
Enter the router's own address in the VL.id: Masukkan alamat router sendiri di VLAN, seperti {ex}, bukan alamat network.
Enter the router's own address in the VL.it: Inserisci l'indirizzo del router nella VLAN, ad esempio {ex}, non l'indirizzo di rete.
Enter the router's own address in the VL.tr: Ağ adresini değil, yönlendiricinin VLAN içindeki kendi adresini girin, örneğin {ex}.
Enter the router's own address in the VL.vi: Hãy nhập địa chỉ riêng của router trong VLAN, chẳng hạn {ex}, không phải địa chỉ mạng.
Enter the router's own address in the VL.ru: Введите собственный адрес маршрутизатора в этой VLAN, например {ex}, а не адрес сети.
Enter the router's own address in the VL.pl: Wpisz własny adres routera w tym VLAN-ie, na przykład {ex}, a nie adres sieci.
Enter the router's own address in the VL.hi: VLAN में राउटर का अपना पता डालें, जैसे {ex}, नेटवर्क एड्रेस नहीं।

The bridge itself is added to VLANs auto.es: El propio bridge se agrega a las VLAN automáticamente; lista aquí los puertos físicos.
The bridge itself is added to VLANs auto.pt-BR: A própria bridge é adicionada às VLANs automaticamente; liste aqui as portas físicas.
The bridge itself is added to VLANs auto.fr: Le bridge lui-même est ajouté automatiquement aux VLAN ; listez ici les ports physiques.
The bridge itself is added to VLANs auto.de: Die Bridge selbst wird automatisch zu VLANs hinzugefügt; listen Sie hier physische Ports auf.
The bridge itself is added to VLANs auto.id: Bridge sendiri ditambahkan ke VLAN secara otomatis; tuliskan port fisik di sini.
The bridge itself is added to VLANs auto.it: Il bridge stesso viene aggiunto automaticamente alle VLAN; qui elenca le porte fisiche.
The bridge itself is added to VLANs auto.tr: Köprünün kendisi VLAN'lara otomatik eklenir; burada fiziksel portları listeleyin.
The bridge itself is added to VLANs auto.vi: Bản thân bridge được tự động thêm vào các VLAN; hãy liệt kê các cổng vật lý ở đây.
The bridge itself is added to VLANs auto.ru: Сам мост добавляется в VLAN автоматически; здесь перечисляйте физические порты.
The bridge itself is added to VLANs auto.pl: Sam bridge jest dodawany do VLAN-ów automatycznie; tutaj wypisz porty fizyczne.
The bridge itself is added to VLANs auto.hi: ब्रिज खुद VLAN में अपने आप जुड़ जाता है; यहाँ फ़िज़िकल पोर्ट लिखें।

VLAN {id} isn't in the VLAN list above..es: La VLAN {id} no está en la lista de VLAN de arriba.
VLAN {id} isn't in the VLAN list above..pt-BR: A VLAN {id} não está na lista de VLANs acima.
VLAN {id} isn't in the VLAN list above..fr: Le VLAN {id} n'est pas dans la liste de VLAN ci-dessus.
VLAN {id} isn't in the VLAN list above..de: VLAN {id} steht nicht in der obigen VLAN-Liste.
VLAN {id} isn't in the VLAN list above..id: VLAN {id} tidak ada di daftar VLAN di atas.
VLAN {id} isn't in the VLAN list above..it: La VLAN {id} non è nell'elenco VLAN qui sopra.
VLAN {id} isn't in the VLAN list above..vi: VLAN {id} không có trong danh sách VLAN ở trên.
VLAN {id} isn't in the VLAN list above..ru: VLAN {id} нет в списке VLAN выше.
VLAN {id} isn't in the VLAN list above..pl: VLAN {id} nie występuje na powyższej liście VLAN-ów.
VLAN {id} isn't in the VLAN list above..hi: VLAN {id} ऊपर की VLAN लिस्ट में नहीं है।

List the VLAN IDs this port carries tagg.es: Lista los ID de VLAN que este puerto transporta con etiqueta, o escribe all.
List the VLAN IDs this port carries tagg.pt-BR: Liste os IDs de VLAN que esta porta transporta com tag, ou escreva all.
List the VLAN IDs this port carries tagg.fr: Listez les ID de VLAN que ce port transporte avec tag, ou écrivez all.
List the VLAN IDs this port carries tagg.de: Listen Sie die VLAN-IDs auf, die dieser Port tagged führt, oder schreiben Sie all.
List the VLAN IDs this port carries tagg.id: Tuliskan ID VLAN yang dibawa port ini secara tagged, atau tulis all.
List the VLAN IDs this port carries tagg.it: Elenca gli ID VLAN che questa porta trasporta tagged, oppure scrivi all.
List the VLAN IDs this port carries tagg.tr: Bu portun etiketli taşıdığı VLAN kimliklerini listeleyin veya all yazın.
List the VLAN IDs this port carries tagg.vi: Hãy liệt kê các VLAN ID mà cổng này mang dưới dạng tagged, hoặc ghi all.
List the VLAN IDs this port carries tagg.ru: Перечислите VLAN ID, которые порт передаёт с тегом, или напишите all.
List the VLAN IDs this port carries tagg.pl: Wypisz ID VLAN-ów, które ten port przenosi z tagiem, albo wpisz all.
List the VLAN IDs this port carries tagg.hi: इस पोर्ट पर tagged रूप में चलने वाले VLAN ID लिखें, या all लिखें।

VLAN {id} is already this port's untagge.es: La VLAN {id} ya es la VLAN untagged de este puerto; un puerto no puede transportarla también con etiqueta.
VLAN {id} is already this port's untagge.pt-BR: A VLAN {id} já é a VLAN sem tag desta porta; uma porta não pode transportá-la também com tag.
VLAN {id} is already this port's untagge.fr: Le VLAN {id} est déjà le VLAN sans tag de ce port ; un port ne peut pas le transporter aussi avec tag.
VLAN {id} is already this port's untagge.de: VLAN {id} ist bereits das untagged VLAN dieses Ports; ein Port kann es nicht zusätzlich tagged führen.
VLAN {id} is already this port's untagge.id: VLAN {id} sudah menjadi VLAN untagged port ini; port tidak bisa membawanya secara tagged juga.
VLAN {id} is already this port's untagge.it: La VLAN {id} è già la VLAN untagged di questa porta; una porta non può trasportarla anche tagged.
VLAN {id} is already this port's untagge.tr: VLAN {id} zaten bu portun etiketsiz VLAN'ı; bir port onu aynı zamanda etiketli taşıyamaz.
VLAN {id} is already this port's untagge.vi: VLAN {id} đã là VLAN untagged của cổng này; một cổng không thể mang nó dưới dạng tagged cùng lúc.
VLAN {id} is already this port's untagge.ru: VLAN {id} уже является VLAN без тега для этого порта; порт не может передавать её ещё и с тегом.
VLAN {id} is already this port's untagge.pl: VLAN {id} jest już VLAN-em bez tagu tego portu; port nie może przenosić go jednocześnie z tagiem.
VLAN {id} is already this port's untagge.hi: VLAN {id} पहले से इस पोर्ट का untagged VLAN है; पोर्ट इसे tagged रूप में भी नहीं रख सकता।

VLAN {id} has no ports..hi: VLAN {id} में कोई पोर्ट नहीं है।

With the bridge set to tagged frames onl.es: Con el bridge configurado para aceptar solo tramas con etiqueta, cualquier dirección IP en el propio bridge deja de responder. Administra el router mediante una interfaz VLAN.
With the bridge set to tagged frames onl.pt-BR: Com a bridge configurada para aceitar apenas quadros com tag, qualquer endereço IP na própria bridge deixa de responder. Gerencie o roteador por uma interface VLAN.
With the bridge set to tagged frames onl.fr: Quand le bridge est réglé sur les trames tagged uniquement, toute adresse IP sur le bridge lui-même cesse de répondre. Administrez le routeur via une interface VLAN.
With the bridge set to tagged frames onl.de: Ist die Bridge auf nur tagged Frames gestellt, antwortet jede IP-Adresse auf der Bridge selbst nicht mehr. Verwalten Sie den Router über ein VLAN-Interface.
With the bridge set to tagged frames onl.id: Dengan bridge diatur hanya untuk frame bertag, alamat IP apa pun pada bridge itu sendiri berhenti menjawab. Kelola router lewat interface VLAN.
With the bridge set to tagged frames onl.it: Con il bridge impostato sui soli frame tagged, qualsiasi indirizzo IP sul bridge stesso smette di rispondere. Gestisci il router tramite un'interfaccia VLAN.
With the bridge set to tagged frames onl.tr: Köprü yalnızca etiketli çerçevelere ayarlandığında, köprünün kendisindeki IP adresleri yanıt vermeyi bırakır. Yönlendiriciyi bir VLAN arayüzü üzerinden yönetin.
With the bridge set to tagged frames onl.vi: Khi bridge được đặt chỉ nhận frame tagged, mọi địa chỉ IP trên chính bridge sẽ ngừng phản hồi. Hãy quản lý router qua một giao diện VLAN.
With the bridge set to tagged frames onl.ru: Если мост настроен только на кадры с тегами, любой IP-адрес на самом мосту перестаёт отвечать. Управляйте маршрутизатором через интерфейс VLAN.
With the bridge set to tagged frames onl.pl: Gdy bridge przyjmuje tylko ramki z tagiem, żaden adres IP na samym bridge'u nie odpowiada. Zarządzaj routerem przez interfejs VLAN.
With the bridge set to tagged frames onl.hi: ब्रिज को सिर्फ़ tagged फ़्रेम पर सेट करने पर ब्रिज के अपने IP एड्रेस जवाब देना बंद कर देते हैं। राउटर को VLAN इंटरफ़ेस से मैनेज करें।

After VLAN filtering is on, the router a.es: Después de activar el VLAN filtering, el router responde en {list}. Tu computadora debe estar en una de esas VLAN, mediante un puerto access o un trunk tagged, o perderás el acceso.
After VLAN filtering is on, the router a.pt-BR: Depois que o VLAN filtering for ligado, o roteador responderá em {list}. Seu computador precisa estar em uma dessas VLANs, por uma porta access ou um trunk com tag, ou você perde o acesso.
After VLAN filtering is on, the router a.fr: Une fois le filtrage VLAN activé, le routeur répond sur {list}. Votre ordinateur doit se trouver sur l'un de ces VLAN, via un port access ou un trunk tagged, sinon vous perdez l'accès.
After VLAN filtering is on, the router a.de: Nachdem das VLAN-Filtering an ist, antwortet der Router auf {list}. Ihr Rechner muss in einem dieser VLANs sein, über einen Access-Port oder einen tagged Trunk, sonst verlieren Sie den Zugang.
After VLAN filtering is on, the router a.id: Setelah VLAN filtering aktif, router menjawab di {list}. Komputer Anda harus berada di salah satu VLAN itu, lewat port access atau trunk bertag, atau akses Anda hilang.
After VLAN filtering is on, the router a.it: Dopo l'attivazione del VLAN filtering, il router risponde su {list}. Il tuo computer deve trovarsi su una di queste VLAN, tramite una porta access o un trunk tagged, altrimenti perdi l'accesso.
After VLAN filtering is on, the router a.tr: VLAN filtreleme açıldıktan sonra yönlendirici {list} üzerinde yanıt verir. Bilgisayarınız bu VLAN'lardan birinde, bir access portu veya etiketli trunk üzerinden bağlı olmalıdır; aksi halde erişimi kaybedersiniz.
After VLAN filtering is on, the router a.vi: Sau khi bật lọc VLAN, router phản hồi trên {list}. Máy tính của bạn phải nằm trong một trong các VLAN đó, qua cổng access hoặc trunk tagged, nếu không bạn sẽ mất quyền truy cập.
After VLAN filtering is on, the router a.ru: После включения фильтрации VLAN маршрутизатор отвечает по адресам: {list}. Ваш компьютер должен находиться в одной из этих VLAN, через порт access или trunk с тегами, иначе вы потеряете доступ.
After VLAN filtering is on, the router a.pl: Po włączeniu filtrowania VLAN router odpowiada na: {list}. Twój komputer musi być w jednym z tych VLAN-ów, przez port access lub trunk z tagiem, bo inaczej stracisz dostęp.
After VLAN filtering is on, the router a.hi: VLAN फ़िल्टरिंग चालू होने के बाद राउटर {list} पर जवाब देगा। आपका कंप्यूटर इनमें से किसी एक VLAN पर होना चाहिए, access पोर्ट या tagged trunk के ज़रिए, वरना आपकी पहुँच बंद हो जाएगी।

No VLAN has a router address, so the rou.es: Ninguna VLAN tiene una dirección del router, así que el router solo se puede administrar mediante una dirección en el propio bridge (untagged, PVID 1) u otra interfaz. Asegúrate de que una siga siendo accesible.
No VLAN has a router address, so the rou.pt-BR: Nenhuma VLAN tem endereço do roteador, então o roteador só pode ser gerenciado por um endereço na própria bridge (sem tag, PVID 1) ou em outra interface. Garanta que um continue acessível.
No VLAN has a router address, so the rou.fr: Aucun VLAN n'a d'adresse du routeur : le routeur ne peut donc être administré que via une adresse sur le bridge lui-même (sans tag, PVID 1) ou une autre interface. Assurez-vous que l'une reste joignable.
No VLAN has a router address, so the rou.de: Kein VLAN hat eine Router-Adresse, der Router lässt sich daher nur über eine Adresse auf der Bridge selbst (untagged, PVID 1) oder ein anderes Interface verwalten. Stellen Sie sicher, dass eines erreichbar bleibt.
No VLAN has a router address, so the rou.id: Tidak ada VLAN yang punya alamat router, sehingga router hanya bisa dikelola lewat alamat pada bridge itu sendiri (untagged, PVID 1) atau interface lain. Pastikan salah satunya tetap bisa dijangkau.
No VLAN has a router address, so the rou.it: Nessuna VLAN ha un indirizzo del router, quindi il router si può gestire solo tramite un indirizzo sul bridge stesso (untagged, PVID 1) o su un'altra interfaccia. Assicurati che ne resti raggiungibile una.
No VLAN has a router address, so the rou.tr: Hiçbir VLAN'ın yönlendirici adresi yok; bu yüzden yönlendirici yalnızca köprünün kendisindeki (etiketsiz, PVID 1) ya da başka bir arayüzdeki adres üzerinden yönetilebilir. Birinin erişilebilir kaldığından emin olun.
No VLAN has a router address, so the rou.vi: Không VLAN nào có địa chỉ router, nên chỉ có thể quản lý router qua một địa chỉ trên chính bridge (untagged, PVID 1) hoặc giao diện khác. Hãy đảm bảo vẫn còn một đường truy cập được.
No VLAN has a router address, so the rou.ru: Ни у одной VLAN нет адреса маршрутизатора, поэтому управлять им можно только через адрес на самом мосту (без тега, PVID 1) или на другом интерфейсе. Убедитесь, что хотя бы один остаётся доступным.
No VLAN has a router address, so the rou.pl: Żaden VLAN nie ma adresu routera, więc routerem można zarządzać tylko przez adres na samym bridge'u (bez tagu, PVID 1) lub na innym interfejsie. Upewnij się, że któryś pozostanie osiągalny.
No VLAN has a router address, so the rou.hi: किसी भी VLAN में राउटर एड्रेस नहीं है, इसलिए राउटर को सिर्फ़ ब्रिज के अपने पते (untagged, PVID 1) या किसी दूसरे इंटरफ़ेस के पते से मैनेज किया जा सकता है। पक्का करें कि कोई एक पहुँच में बना रहे।

VLAN 1 is the bridge's default PVID. Usi.es: La VLAN 1 es el PVID por defecto del bridge. Usarla para tráfico real funciona, pero es fácil de confundir con el tráfico untagged; un ID separado es más claro.
VLAN 1 is the bridge's default PVID. Usi.pt-BR: A VLAN 1 é o PVID padrão da bridge. Usá-la para tráfego real funciona, mas é fácil confundi-la com o tráfego sem tag; um ID separado é mais claro.
VLAN 1 is the bridge's default PVID. Usi.fr: Le VLAN 1 est le PVID par défaut du bridge. L'utiliser pour du trafic réel fonctionne mais se confond facilement avec le trafic sans tag ; un ID distinct est plus clair.
VLAN 1 is the bridge's default PVID. Usi.de: VLAN 1 ist die Standard-PVID der Bridge. Es für echten Verkehr zu nutzen funktioniert, lässt sich aber leicht mit untagged Verkehr verwechseln; eine eigene ID ist klarer.
VLAN 1 is the bridge's default PVID. Usi.id: VLAN 1 adalah PVID default bridge. Memakainya untuk lalu lintas nyata bisa berfungsi tetapi mudah tertukar dengan lalu lintas untagged; ID terpisah lebih jelas.
VLAN 1 is the bridge's default PVID. Usi.it: La VLAN 1 è il PVID predefinito del bridge. Usarla per traffico reale funziona, ma è facile confonderla con il traffico untagged; un ID separato è più chiaro.
VLAN 1 is the bridge's default PVID. Usi.tr: VLAN 1, köprünün varsayılan PVID'idir. Gerçek trafik için kullanmak çalışır ancak etiketsiz trafikle karıştırılması kolaydır; ayrı bir kimlik daha açıktır.
VLAN 1 is the bridge's default PVID. Usi.vi: VLAN 1 là PVID mặc định của bridge. Dùng nó cho lưu lượng thực vẫn chạy được nhưng dễ nhầm với lưu lượng untagged; dùng một ID riêng sẽ rõ ràng hơn.
VLAN 1 is the bridge's default PVID. Usi.ru: VLAN 1 — PVID моста по умолчанию. Использовать её для реального трафика можно, но её легко спутать с трафиком без тега; отдельный ID нагляднее.
VLAN 1 is the bridge's default PVID. Usi.pl: VLAN 1 to domyślny PVID bridge'a. Używanie go do prawdziwego ruchu działa, ale łatwo go pomylić z ruchem bez tagu; osobne ID jest czytelniejsze.
VLAN 1 is the bridge's default PVID. Usi.hi: VLAN 1 ब्रिज का डिफ़ॉल्ट PVID है। असली ट्रैफ़िक के लिए इसे इस्तेमाल करना चलता है, पर untagged ट्रैफ़िक से गड़बड़ाना आसान है; अलग ID रखना ज़्यादा साफ़ रहता है।

The port lines use set [ find interface=.es: Las líneas de puertos usan set [ find interface=… ], así que cada puerto ya debe estar en {bridge}.
The port lines use set [ find interface=.pt-BR: As linhas das portas usam set [ find interface=… ], então cada porta já deve estar em {bridge}.
The port lines use set [ find interface=.fr: Les lignes de ports utilisent set [ find interface=… ], donc chaque port doit déjà être dans {bridge}.
The port lines use set [ find interface=.de: Die Port-Zeilen verwenden set [ find interface=… ], daher muss jeder Port bereits in {bridge} sein.
The port lines use set [ find interface=.id: Baris port memakai set [ find interface=… ], jadi setiap port harus sudah ada di {bridge}.
The port lines use set [ find interface=.it: Le righe delle porte usano set [ find interface=… ], quindi ogni porta deve già far parte di {bridge}.
The port lines use set [ find interface=.tr: Port satırları set [ find interface=… ] kullanır, bu yüzden her port zaten {bridge} içinde olmalıdır.
The port lines use set [ find interface=.vi: Các dòng cổng dùng set [ find interface=… ], nên mỗi cổng phải đã nằm trong {bridge}.
The port lines use set [ find interface=.ru: В строках портов используется set [ find interface=… ], поэтому каждый порт уже должен входить в {bridge}.
The port lines use set [ find interface=.pl: Wiersze portów używają set [ find interface=… ], więc każdy port musi już należeć do {bridge}.
The port lines use set [ find interface=.hi: पोर्ट वाली लाइनें set [ find interface=… ] इस्तेमाल करती हैं, इसलिए हर पोर्ट का {bridge} में पहले से होना ज़रूरी है।

If a port is already in a bridge (the de.es: Si un puerto ya está en un bridge (la configuración por defecto pone ether2 a ether5 en "bridge"), agregarlo falla. Marca "Los puertos ya están en el bridge" o quítalos primero.
If a port is already in a bridge (the de.pt-BR: Se uma porta já está em uma bridge (a configuração padrão coloca ether2 a ether5 em "bridge"), adicioná-la falha. Marque "As portas já estão na bridge" ou remova-as antes.
If a port is already in a bridge (the de.fr: Si un port est déjà dans un bridge (la configuration par défaut met ether2 à ether5 dans « bridge »), l'ajouter échoue. Cochez « Les ports sont déjà dans le bridge » ou retirez-les d'abord.
If a port is already in a bridge (the de.de: Ist ein Port schon in einer Bridge (die Standardkonfiguration legt ether2 bis ether5 in "bridge"), schlägt das Hinzufügen fehl. Setzen Sie den Haken bei "Die Ports sind bereits in der Bridge" oder entfernen Sie sie zuerst.
If a port is already in a bridge (the de.id: Jika port sudah ada di sebuah bridge (konfigurasi default memasukkan ether2 sampai ether5 ke "bridge"), menambahkannya gagal. Centang "Port sudah ada di bridge" atau keluarkan dulu.
If a port is already in a bridge (the de.it: Se una porta è già in un bridge (la configurazione predefinita mette da ether2 a ether5 in "bridge"), l'aggiunta non riesce. Seleziona "Le porte sono già nel bridge" oppure rimuovile prima.
If a port is already in a bridge (the de.tr: Bir port zaten bir köprüdeyse (varsayılan yapılandırma ether2'den ether5'e kadar olanları "bridge" içine koyar) eklemek başarısız olur. "Portlar zaten köprüde" kutusunu işaretleyin veya önce bunları kaldırın.
If a port is already in a bridge (the de.vi: Nếu một cổng đã nằm trong một bridge (cấu hình mặc định đặt ether2 đến ether5 vào "bridge"), việc thêm sẽ thất bại. Hãy chọn "Ports are already in the bridge" hoặc xóa chúng khỏi bridge trước.
If a port is already in a bridge (the de.ru: Если порт уже входит в мост (в конфигурации по умолчанию ether2–ether5 входят в «bridge»), добавить его не получится. Отметьте «Порты уже в мосту» или сначала удалите их.
If a port is already in a bridge (the de.pl: Jeśli port jest już w bridge'u (konfiguracja domyślna umieszcza ether2–ether5 w „bridge”), jego dodanie się nie powiedzie. Zaznacz „Porty są już w bridge'u” albo najpierw je usuń.
If a port is already in a bridge (the de.hi: अगर कोई पोर्ट पहले से किसी ब्रिज में है (डिफ़ॉल्ट कॉन्फ़िगरेशन ether2 से ether5 को "bridge" में रखता है), तो उसे जोड़ना विफल होगा। "पोर्ट पहले से ब्रिज में हैं" चुनें या पहले उन्हें हटाएँ।

Many MikroTik switches offload bridge VL.es: Muchos switches MikroTik aceleran por hardware el bridge VLAN filtering en el chip del switch solo en algunos modelos y versiones de RouterOS. Revisa la bandera H en /interface bridge port print; sin ella, el VLAN filtering se ejecuta en el CPU.
Many MikroTik switches offload bridge VL.pt-BR: Muitos switches MikroTik só fazem offload do bridge VLAN filtering para o switch chip em alguns modelos e versões do RouterOS. Confira a flag H em /interface bridge port print; sem ela, o VLAN filtering roda na CPU.
Many MikroTik switches offload bridge VL.fr: De nombreux switches MikroTik n'accélèrent le bridge VLAN filtering par la puce du switch que sur certains modèles et versions de RouterOS. Vérifiez le drapeau H dans /interface bridge port print ; sans lui, le filtrage VLAN s'exécute sur le CPU.
Many MikroTik switches offload bridge VL.de: Viele MikroTik-Switches lagern Bridge-VLAN-Filtering nur bei einigen Modellen und RouterOS-Versionen in den Switch-Chip aus. Prüfen Sie das H-Flag in /interface bridge port print; ohne es läuft das VLAN-Filtering auf der CPU.
Many MikroTik switches offload bridge VL.id: Banyak switch MikroTik hanya meng-offload bridge VLAN filtering ke switch chip pada model dan versi RouterOS tertentu. Periksa flag H di /interface bridge port print; tanpanya, VLAN filtering berjalan di CPU.
Many MikroTik switches offload bridge VL.it: Molti switch MikroTik delegano il VLAN filtering del bridge al chip dello switch solo su alcuni modelli e versioni di RouterOS. Controlla il flag H in /interface bridge port print; senza di esso il VLAN filtering viene eseguito dalla CPU.
Many MikroTik switches offload bridge VL.tr: Birçok MikroTik switch'i, köprü VLAN filtrelemesini yalnızca bazı model ve RouterOS sürümlerinde switch çipine devreder. /interface bridge port print içindeki H bayrağını kontrol edin; yoksa VLAN filtreleme CPU üzerinde çalışır.
Many MikroTik switches offload bridge VL.vi: Nhiều switch MikroTik chỉ chuyển việc lọc VLAN của bridge sang chip switch trên một số model và phiên bản RouterOS. Hãy kiểm tra cờ H trong /interface bridge port print; nếu không có, việc lọc VLAN chạy trên CPU.
Many MikroTik switches offload bridge VL.ru: Многие коммутаторы MikroTik переносят фильтрацию VLAN моста на чип коммутатора только на некоторых моделях и версиях RouterOS. Проверьте флаг H в /interface bridge port print; без него фильтрация VLAN выполняется на процессоре.
Many MikroTik switches offload bridge VL.pl: Wiele przełączników MikroTik przenosi filtrowanie VLAN bridge'a na układ przełączający tylko w niektórych modelach i wersjach RouterOS. Sprawdź flagę H w /interface bridge port print; bez niej filtrowanie VLAN działa na CPU.
Many MikroTik switches offload bridge VL.hi: कई MikroTik स्विच ब्रिज VLAN फ़िल्टरिंग को सिर्फ़ कुछ मॉडल और RouterOS वर्शन पर ही स्विच चिप को सौंपते हैं। /interface bridge port print में H फ़्लैग देखें; वह न हो तो VLAN फ़िल्टरिंग CPU पर चलती है।
